column2: These troopers carry an advanced 'Man-portable air-defense system'. This weapon fires missiles that home in on their target but carry a fairly light explosive payload.
This operator has a direct communication line to a TAC Fighter group.These will strafe the enemy with missiles which excel against low numbers of armored targets.
These ground crews are often the first to arrive in a warzone to prepare airfields and set up defenses.They are well trained and carry Morita Carbines for personal defense.
High rate of fire effective against large numbers of lightly armored enemies and airborne targets.Light frame make its vulnerable to enemy attacks.
With a direct communication line to an orbital Corvette Transport, this officer can call for reinforcements and provides orbital fire support.
TO DO The nest must be destroyed to permanently stop the creatures from flying out of it.
Effective against small numbers of heavily armored targets.
Effective against against concentrated groups of unarmored targets.
Call down a drop pod from orbit that boosts the construction and repair speed of nearby Fleet Mechanics units.
Call down a drop pod from orbit that boosts the rate of fire of nearby Marines. Be aware that the ammunition may explode when attacked.
Provide indirect fire support with a steady barrage of fragmentation grenades. Effective against lightly armored targets.
